intent: Who reviews a turf project for a reader in Arcadian Shores or Springmaid Beach — the City of Myrtle Beach or Horry County — and what, if anything, a voluntary neighborhood association adds on top of that.
distinctValue: Arcadian Shores is unincorporated Horry County land organized as a Special Tax District, not part of the City of Myrtle Beach; its single-family homeowners' association is voluntary and its by-laws point members to a Declaration of Restrictions we could not open ourselves, so the page tells a reader to pull the recorded copy from the county Register of Deeds rather than guess at its content. Springmaid Beach has no government or association of its own; the only thing worth adding for that name is that the Myrtle Beach city line runs through the area rather than around it, so a reader there should confirm which side of the line their parcel is on before assuming city review applies.
